message.name: CustomerPaymentStatusReportV15
message.definition: Scope|The CustomerPaymentStatusReport message is sent by an instructed agent to the previous party in the payment chain. It is used to inform this party about the positive or negative status of an instruction (either single or file). It is also used to report on a pending instruction.|Usage|The CustomerPaymentStatusReport message is exchanged between an agent and a non-financial institution customer to provide status information on instructions previously sent. Its usage may be governed by a bilateral or multilateral agreement between the agent and the non-financial institution customer.|The CustomerPaymentStatusReport message can be used to provide information about the status (for example a rejection, an acceptance) of the initiation of a credit transfer, a direct debit, as well as on the initiation of other customer instructions.|The CustomerPaymentStatusReport message refers to the original instruction(s) by means of references only or by means of references and a set of elements from the original instruction.|The CustomerPaymentStatusReport message can be used in domestic and cross-border scenarios.|The CustomerPaymentStatusReport may also be sent to the receiver of the payment in a real time payment scenario, as both sides of the transactions must be informed of the status of the transaction (that is either the beneficiary is credited, or the transaction is rejected).

rules.name: StatusReasonRule
rules.text: If Reason/Code is equal to NARR, then AddititionalInformation must be present.

rules.name: StatusReasonInformationRule
rules.text: If GroupStatus is present and is different from RJCT or PDNG then StatusReasonInformation/AdditionalInformation must be absent.

rules.name: NumberOfTransactionPerStatusGuideline
rules.text: OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/NumberOfTransactionsPerStatus should only be present if GroupStatus equals 'PART'.

rules.name: IdentificationOrProxyPresenceRule
rules.text: Identification must be present or Proxy must be present. Both may be present.

rules.name: IdentificationAndProxyGuideline
rules.text: If the account identification is not defined through a conventional identification such as an email address or a mobile number, then the proxy element should be used for the identification of the account.

rules.name: ThirdReimbursementAgentRule
rules.text: If ThirdReimbursementAgent is present, then InstructingReimbursementAgent and InstructedReimbursementAgent must both be present.

rules.name: SettlementMethodAgentRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to INDA or INGA, then ReimbursementAgent(s) and ClearingSystem are not allowed.

rules.name: SettlementMethodCoverRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to COVE, then SettlementAccount and ClearingSystem are not allowed.

rules.name: SettlementMethodCoverAgentRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to COVE, then InstructedReimbursementAgent or InstructingReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: SettlementMethodClearingRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to CLRG, then SettlementAccount and ReimbursementAgent(s) are not allowed.

rules.name: InstructingReimbursementAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If InstructingReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then InstructingReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: InstructedReimbursementAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If InstructedReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then InstructedReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: ThirdReimbursementAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If ThirdReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then ThirdReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: AmendmentIndicatorTrueRule
rules.text: If AmendmentIndicator is true, then AmendmentInformationDetails must be present.

rules.name: AmendmentIndicatorFalseRule
rules.text: If AmendmentIndicator is false, then AmendmentInformationDetails is not allowed.

rules.name: RemittanceAmountAndTypeGuideline
rules.text: If Type/Code is equal to CREN, DUPA or REMI for RemittanceAmountAndType, RemittanceAmountAndType must not be repeated.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: PaymentInformationStatusAcceptedRule
rules.text: If PaymentInformationStatus is present and is equal to ACTC (AcceptedTechnicalValidation), ACCP (AcceptedCustomerProfile), ACSP (AcceptedSettlementInProcess), ACSC (AcceptedSettlementCompleted) or ACWC (AcceptedWithChange), then TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus must be different from RJCT (Rejected).

rules.name: PaymentInformationStatusPendingRule
rules.text: If OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/PaymentInformationStatus is present and is equal to PDNG (Pending), then TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus must be different from RJCT (Rejected).

rules.name: PaymentInformationStatusRejectedRule
rules.text: If OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/PaymentInformationStatus is present and is equal to RJCT (Rejceted), then TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus, if present, must be equal to RJCT (Rejected).

rules.name: PaymentInformationStatusReceivedRule
rules.text: If OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/PaymentInformationStatus is present and is equal to RCVD (Received), then TransactionInformationAndStatus/TransactionStatus is not allowed.

rules.name: GroupStatusAcceptedRule
rules.text: If OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/GroupStatus is present and is equal to ACTC (AcceptedTechnicalValidation), ACCP (AcceptedCustomerProfile), ACSP (AcceptedSettlementInProcess), ACSC (AcceptedSettlementCompleted) or ACWC (AcceptedWithChange), then OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/PaymentInformationStatus must be different from RJCT (Rejected).

rules.name: GroupStatusPendingRule
rules.text: If OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/GroupStatus is present and is equal to PDNG (Pending), then OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/PaymentInformationStatus must be different from RJCT (Rejected).

rules.name: GroupStatusRejectedRule
rules.text: If OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/GroupStatus is present and is equal to RJCT (Rejected), then OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/PaymentInformationStatus, if present, must be equal to RJCT (Rejected).

rules.name: GroupStatusReceivedRule
rules.text: If OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/GroupStatus is present and is equal to RCVD (Received), then OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus/PaymentInformationStatus is not allowed.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: The SupplementaryData building block at message level must not be used to provide additional information about a transaction. The SupplementaryData element at transaction level should be used for that purpose.
